name: Salvation's Grip

frame.name: Cryocannon
frame.description:
[Shoot]  : Hold to charge; release to fire.
This weapon's charged projectiles create a pattern of Stasis crystals on impact and freeze nearby targets.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.description:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.description:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Shatter Shot
perks.description: This weapon's uncharged projectiles deal bonus damage to Stasis crystals and frozen targets. Rapidly destroying multiple Stasis crystals reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

flavor: "I respect what I cannot steal from and you cannot take from the dark." —Excerpt from an old Eliksni salvage manifest

catalyst.name: Salvation's Grip Catalyst
catalyst.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.
